result.instructions: Tools for Documint, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which document templates do I have in Documint?"; "Create a PDF from my Sales Invoice template for Acme Ltd with the total 1,200 EUR."; "Show me the details of my Sales Contract template.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Documint data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run documint_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run documint_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run documint_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. documint_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: documint_list_templates
tools.title: List templates
tools.description: List the document templates in your Documint account with their ids, names and created dates. Start here to find a template id for documint_merge_template. Documint API: GET /templates.

sort.description: Sort field, for example name or -createdAt (- means descending).

select.description: Comma-separated fields to return, for example name,createdAt. Put - before a field to leave it out.

tools.name: documint_get_template
tools.title: Get template
tools.description: Get one document template by its id. Documint API: GET /templates/{id}.

select.description: Comma-separated fields to return, for example name,createdAt. Put - before a field to leave it out.

tools.name: documint_merge_template
tools.title: Merge template into a PDF
tools.description: Merge field values into a template and create a PDF document. Each call creates a new document in your Documint account and uses one document from your plan. Returns the hosted PDF url and the document name. Documint API: POST /templates/{id}/content.

data.description: Field values for the template as one JSON object: field name to value, for example {"customer_name": "Acme Ltd"}.

preview.description: Sends the preview flag. The reference does not define it; leave it out unless you need it.

active.description: Sends the active flag. The reference does not define it; leave it out unless you need it.
